snippet.title: Heritage - Gameplay Trailer (Free PC Game)
snippet.description:
http://www.freepcgamers.com/2012/04/heritage.html

Horror games are few and far between and even popular franchises such as Resident Evil and Silent Hill abandoned most of the scary elements in favor of a more commercial approach -- meaning more combat and less atmosphere. So it's great when small indie studio BLF decides to release a freeware horror adventure game much in the same style as classics such as 7th Guest and 11th Hour.
